name: What is the difference between porcelain tile and natural marble in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between porcelain tile and natural marble in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic and porcelain tile offer superior water resistance, durability, and easy maintenance, making them ideal for shower walls, floors, and vanity surrounds. Natural marble adds high-end visual elegance and unique graining, but it is porous and requires regular sealing to avoid staining from toiletries and hard water. Choosing porcelain tile that mimics marble gives you the luxury appearance without the ongoing maintenance and moisture sensitivity of raw stone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is non-porous, highly durable, and low-maintenance, while natural marble delivers luxury appeal but requires routine sealing to resist moisture and stains.
